Coram : SHIVARAJ V. PATIL*, D.M. DHARMADHIKARI
Arbitration and Conciliation Act, 1996-Sections 11 and 16-Constitution of India, 1950-Article 226-Nominee or designate of Chief Justice-Dispute C regarding validity and existence of arbitration agreement and its reference to arbitrator-Jurisdiction to adjudicate-Held: Designate of the Chief no jurisdiction to adjudicate upon such dispute and also the High Court exercising power under Article 226 has no jurisdiction-Only arbitral Tribunal is conferred with jurisdiction to decide such dispute as provided under Section D 16(1). Appellant-Corporation filed an application for reference
Decision Date : 30-07-2003 | Case No : ARBITRATION PETITION No. 5315/2003 | Disposal Nature : Appeal(s) allowed | Bench : 2 Judges
